Multiplies the learning rate by gamma after every epoch.

torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ExponentialLR: lr = learning_rate x gamma^epoch, stepped after each completed epoch.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Training](../categories/training.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `ExponentialLR` |
| Search words | exponential, scheduler, learning rate, decay |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Optimizer** | Optimizer | Yes | 1 | The training optimizer's State output; this scheduler sets its learning rate |

## Outputs

None: the node ends a branch of the graph.

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Schedule | Gamma | `gamma` | Number | `0.95` | `0.0-1000000.0` | The run | Factor applied after each epoch. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a training control |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
lr = learning_rate * gamma^epoch, set after each completed epoch (torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ExponentialLR).
```

## Tips

- Decays fast: keep gamma close to 1.
